dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>It looks as though the land in this area is held above
the clouds by those bluish-white rocks, <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,10)>giving the

<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>First thing’s first—we’ll have to come up with a way to get
to that island over there.

as nuvens por aquelas rochas brancas azuladas, <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,10)>dando a

<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Primeira coisa: teremos que chegar a uma maneira de chegar

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,6)>What in the world could this be?
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>In all my long years, I’ve never seen a tower quite as odd
as this one. <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,668)><$voicel(1,8)>Would a human really have made this?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,6)>O que poderia ser isto?
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Em todos os meus longos anos, nunca vi uma torre tão estranha
como esta. <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,668)><$voicel(1,8)>Teria um humano realmente feito isto?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>You know, it’s possible there’s another Pokémon
somewhere nearby—<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>one that’s good at building things,
like you!<$motion(1,652)>
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>É possível que haja outro Pokémon
algures por perto...<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>um que é bom em construir coisas,
Como tu!<$motion(1,652)>

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,5)>Now this machine here DOES look human-made.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,5)>Agora esta máquina aqui parece humana.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>But I haven’t a clue how to use it.
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Hmmm... It does appear you can ride on that platform.

<$cdef(27)>?
